objective.name: pilot_output
objective.description: Defines the structured set of cognitive decisions a pilot may request after an inference.

functional._intention_update_note: Optional. New current intention to apply to the continuity before subsequent effects and future inference.
functional._projection_request_note: Optional. Requests a deterministic projection change followed by a new inference. When present, it is exclusive with intentions, wait_group, messages and succession.
functional._intentions_note: Optional. Ordered collection of Brique intentions decided by the pilot. Each intention is a pilot_intention carrying its own await_response; the pilot never chooses any transport detail.
functional._wait_group_note: Optional. Wait group materialized before the awaited intentions it references are invoked. It may reference only intentions of the same output whose await_response is true. At most one new wait group may be requested by a single pilot output.
functional._messages_note: Optional. Addressed messages to materialize after preceding requested effects have been applied.

succession._summary_note: Required. Synthesis of the continuity written for its successor: it becomes the first message of the next continuity, so it must carry what cognition needs to continue.

functional._succession_note: Optional. Decides to continue the work in a new continuity whose first message is the summary; the current continuity is archived. It is exclusive with intentions, wait_group, messages and projection_request, and is applied only when the continuity has no active wait group.
